font-size.comment: Midden-Delfland root/body rem base. Matches middendelfland.nl, which uses a body font-size of 1.12rem (~17.92px / ~18px). Kept under the conduction key so it emits --conduction-root-font-size (same variable name across all themes). Relative unit so the user's browser font-size / zoom is respected (accessibility).
